raw.title: Product Owner/Business Analyst (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Product Owner/Business Analyst (m/f/d)

-Bochum-

 

Shape the Future of Mobility with Us!
Trafineo – Your Path to an Innovative Mobility World

As a leading provider of On-Road-Services and mobility solutions in Europe, we combine the strengths of BP Europa SE (Aral) and Circle K (Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc.). Together, we create innovative services – from toll solutions to electromobility – and shape the mobility of tomorrow.

Our Vision: Creating a world where seamless mobility is a reality.
Our Mission: We deliver innovative and value-adding mobility solutions designed for businesses.

Become part of our team and make a difference – for yourself, for us, and for boundless mobility!


In this role, you will combine elements of Business Analysis, Product Ownership, and Project Management to drive the development and continuous improvement of our digital products and services. Acting as a key link between business stakeholders and technical teams, you will analyze requirements, translate them into practical solutions, and coordinate their implementation. With your strong analytical skills and collaborative mindset, you will help ensure our products meet business and customer needs. 

Your Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and translate business and customer requirements into clear specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria

  • Act as a central point of contact between internal departments, external partners, and development teams, ensuring effective communication and alignment

  • Work closely with the Delivery Lead to coordinate product development, manage dependencies, and ensure the successful delivery of new features and improvements

  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business objectives, customer needs, and technical feasibility

  • Configure and adapt product settings and functionalities to meet specific business and customer requirements

  • Support product releases and provide post-launch support, identifying issues, coordinating necessary adjustments, and driving continuous improvements

  • Analyze complex business processes and clarify operational, legal, or tax-related requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders

  • Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to optimize existing products, workflows, and processes

Your Profile

  • Degree in Business Administration, Business Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or a comparable qualification supported by relevant professional experience

  • Experience in requirements management or business analysis, ideally gained in a product ownership, project management, or comparable role

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex business processes and translate requirements into practical solutions

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge different perspectives and coordinate across teams

  • Collaborative, team-oriented mindset and a structured, solution-focused approach to work

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders

  • Good understanding of IT systems and software development processes, without the need for hands-on technical expertise

  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum or Kanban) and tools such as Jira or Confluence is an advantage

  • Fluent English skills (written and spoken); German skills are a plus

 

Not a perfect match? Apply anyway!

If you bring strong core skills and the motivation to grow, we’re excited to support you.

Why Trafineo? 

  • Security: Join a high-performance team in a rapidly growing market within a future-oriented industry

  • Location & Equipment: Modern office less than five minutes from Bochum main station, equipped with up-to-date workspaces and free on-site parking

  • Attractive Benefits: Enjoy perks such as an Aral Supercard, job bike, fitness subsidy, subsidized lunch, and exclusive discounts through Corporate Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance: 30 days of vacation, 2 additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve, trust-based working hours, and flexible home office options

  • Team & Culture: Be part of an international, collaborative team that values mutual support, open communication, and team spirit

  • Development: Opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and taking on new responsibilities in a dynamic environment 

 

Are you ready to actively shape the future of mobility with us? Then apply now – we look forward to meeting you!

title: Marketing Lead B2B (a)
description: Role overview : The Marketing Lead (B2B) is pivotal in leading the development and execution of Oviva Germany' s Oviva’s B2B marketing strategy in Germany This role will directly drive awareness of Oviva's offering, deepen partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem, and generate qualified leads to support commercial growth You will build an MQL marketing funnel, own and optimize high-impact marketing channels, including Oviva’s Doctors’ Website, national and regional medical conferences, and doctor-facing communication assets. Beyond channel ownership, you will proactively identify new opportunities for strategic collaboration with physicians, institutions, and key industry stakeholders. Job requirements Essential: 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, HCP marketing or lead generation,, ideally within the German healthcare, international pharmaceutical or HealthTech/SaaS sectors. Proven track record of developing a B2B marketing function or inbound funnel Proven track record of managing a B2B website and executing multi-channel campaigns (Print, SEA). Highly analytical mindset: ROI attribution modelling, funnel KPI interpretation, data-driven channel optimisation. Strong writing and editing skills, with an ability to create content that resonates with a business audience/physicians. Strong project management: juggling multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast, pilot-driven environment. Language Qualification: Native-level German and professional fluency in English (C1). Desirable: Strong command of multi-channel HCP marketing: digital channels and traditional channels (print, fax/post, events) Experience working with Medical Affairs or Regulatory teams on compliant healthcare communications. Hands-on experience in conference organisation, including an eye for design. Familiarity with web analytics and design tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Canva, Figma). Job responsibilities Doctor Marketing Strategy & Positioning Lead the planning and execution of the German B2B marketing roadmap Develop segment specific activation strategies across the adoption funnel, ensuring alignment with national commercial milestones and OKRs. Be responsible for a unified narrative for Oviva’s physician engagement across all channels, aligning with brand guidelines and commercial priorities. Adapt global messaging to resonate with local healthcare professionals, ensuring cultural fit and regulatory alignment. Multi-channel Inbound Marketing & Lead Generation Manage and optimize digital paid and organic channels, including placements in medical publications (e.g., Ärzteblatt, doctor newsletters) and online performance marketing (SEA/LinkedIn) to generate MQLs Manage and optimize HCP community and traditional channels Partner with the CRM Manager to build automated nurture journeys Digital Asset Ownership (B2B Website) Take full ownership of the strategy, performance, and optimization of Oviva's B2B Doctors' Website incl content strategy, conversion, SEO, and user experience, acting as the primary lead for its growth and performance Continuously evaluate and refine the user journey for professional audiences, ensuring the website serves as a high converting entry point for the inbound engine. Manage the integration between web assets and CRM systems, ensuring seamless data flow and accurate tracking of the doctor engagement funnel. Coordinate with internal Product and Design teams (or external vendors) to implement website enhancements, maintaining Oviva’s high standards for brand excellence and accessibility. Sales Enablement Create and maintain sales toolkits (brochures, decks, case studies, digital kits) tailored for B2B health audiences. Conduct regular feedback loops with Sales and Field teams to ensure materials meet evolving BD and outreach needs. Co-develop commercial activation campaigns to accelerate deal cycles and support GP network growth. Strategic Events & Partnerships Develop and execute Oviva’s national and regional event roadmap to drive strategic growth and physician engagement. Identify, negotiate, and activate partnerships with healthcare bodies, KOLs, and conference platforms that align with commercial goals. Manage the event marketing budget to maximize brand impact and lead generation efficiency. Conduct post-event performance reviews to extract ROI insights and continuously refine BD engagement tactics. Innovation & Market Intelligence Maintain a deep understanding of the German healthcare landscape (including DiGA and SaaS trends) and competitor activities to ensure Oviva retains its market-leading position. Stay ahead of B2B growth trends, healthcare innovations, and physician marketing strategies relevant to Oviva’s mission. Translate B2B growth trends, competitor insights and market dynamics into strategic inputs for quarterly planning and BD roadmap development and test them applying test-learn-scale principles. Job benefits The opportunity to drive meaningful, life-changing impact through your work. A high-growth environment with strong development opportunities. Flexible working options – including remote working. Personal learning budget and development plans. A home working allowance to create your ideal workspace. Competitive salary (shared in the first screening call) and benefits Having a culture that people want to work in, is very important to us. raw.title: Marketing Lead B2B (a)
raw.description:
Role overview:

The Marketing Lead (B2B) is pivotal in leading the development and execution of Oviva Germany' s Oviva’s B2B marketing strategy in Germany This role will directly drive awareness of Oviva's offering, deepen partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem, and generate qualified leads to support commercial growth

You will build an MQL marketing funnel, own and optimize high-impact marketing channels, including Oviva’s Doctors’ Website, national and regional medical conferences, and doctor-facing communication assets. Beyond channel ownership, you will proactively identify new opportunities for strategic collaboration with physicians, institutions, and key industry stakeholders.

Job requirements

Essential:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, HCP marketing or lead generation,, ideally within the German healthcare, international pharmaceutical or HealthTech/SaaS sectors.

  • Proven track record of developing a B2B marketing function or inbound funnel

  • Proven track record of managing a B2B website and executing multi-channel campaigns (Print, SEA).

  • Highly analytical mindset: ROI attribution modelling, funnel KPI interpretation, data-driven channel optimisation.

  • Strong writing and editing skills, with an ability to create content that resonates with a business audience/physicians.

  • Strong project management: juggling multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast, pilot-driven environment.

  • Language Qualification: Native-level German and professional fluency in English (C1).

Desirable:

  • Strong command of multi-channel HCP marketing: digital channels and traditional channels (print, fax/post, events)

  • Experience working with Medical Affairs or Regulatory teams on compliant healthcare communications.

  • Hands-on experience in conference organisation, including an eye for design.

  • Familiarity with web analytics and design tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Canva, Figma).

Job responsibilities

Doctor Marketing Strategy & Positioning

  • Lead the planning and execution of the German B2B marketing roadmap

  • Develop segment specific activation strategies across the adoption funnel, ensuring alignment with national commercial milestones and OKRs.

  • Be responsible for a unified narrative for Oviva’s physician engagement across all channels, aligning with brand guidelines and commercial priorities.

  • Adapt global messaging to resonate with local healthcare professionals, ensuring cultural fit and regulatory alignment.

Multi-channel Inbound Marketing & Lead Generation

  • Manage and optimize digital paid and organic channels, including placements in medical publications (e.g., Ärzteblatt, doctor newsletters) and online performance marketing (SEA/LinkedIn) to generate MQLs

  • Manage and optimize HCP community and traditional channels

  • Partner with the CRM Manager to build automated nurture journeys

Digital Asset Ownership (B2B Website)

  • Take full ownership of the strategy, performance, and optimization of Oviva's B2B Doctors' Website incl content strategy, conversion, SEO, and user experience, acting as the primary lead for its growth and performance

  • Continuously evaluate and refine the user journey for professional audiences, ensuring the website serves as a high converting entry point for the inbound engine.

  • Manage the integration between web assets and CRM systems, ensuring seamless data flow and accurate tracking of the doctor engagement funnel.

  • Coordinate with internal Product and Design teams (or external vendors) to implement website enhancements, maintaining Oviva’s high standards for brand excellence and accessibility.

Sales Enablement

  • Create and maintain sales toolkits (brochures, decks, case studies, digital kits) tailored for B2B health audiences.

  • Conduct regular feedback loops with Sales and Field teams to ensure materials meet evolving BD and outreach needs.

  • Co-develop commercial activation campaigns to accelerate deal cycles and support GP network growth.

Strategic Events & Partnerships

  • Develop and execute Oviva’s national and regional event roadmap to drive strategic growth and physician engagement.

  • Identify, negotiate, and activate partnerships with healthcare bodies, KOLs, and conference platforms that align with commercial goals.

  • Manage the event marketing budget to maximize brand impact and lead generation efficiency.

  • Conduct post-event performance reviews to extract ROI insights and continuously refine BD engagement tactics.

Innovation & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain a deep understanding of the German healthcare landscape (including DiGA and SaaS trends) and competitor activities to ensure Oviva retains its market-leading position.

  • Stay ahead of B2B growth trends, healthcare innovations, and physician marketing strategies relevant to Oviva’s mission.

  • Translate B2B growth trends, competitor insights and market dynamics into strategic inputs for quarterly planning and BD roadmap development and test them applying test-learn-scale principles.

Job benefits

  • The opportunity to drive meaningful, life-changing impact through your work.

  • A high-growth environment with strong development opportunities.

  • Flexible working options – including remote working.

  • Personal learning budget and development plans.

  • A home working allowance to create your ideal workspace.

  • Competitive salary (shared in the first screening call) and benefits

Having a culture that people want to work in, is very important to us. We do this by keeping our values at the forefront of everything we do:
We put the patient first. We empower our teams. We make it happen

Oviva is passionate about creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diverse voices and perspectives. We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

Ready to help shape the future of digital healthcare? Apply today.

title: Senior Growth Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Als Senior Growth Manager bei LIQID entwickelst du Kampagnenkonzepte, die messbares Wachstum entlang des gesamten Funnels erzeugen – von der Akquisition affluenter Privatkunden bis zu ihrer Aktivierung im Bestand. Du verantwortest Konzept, Kanalplan und Zielerreichung für definierte Themen wie Produkt-Launches, Kanalerschließungen oder Reaktivierungsmaßnahmen. Die operative Umsetzung koordinierst du mit den umsetzenden Einheiten wie Marketing, Investments oder Vertrieb. Damit trägst du direkt zu unserem Wachstum bei. Was machst du dabei konkret? Kampagnenkonzepte: Du entwickelst End-to-End-Konzepte für definierte Wachstumsinitiativen. Dabei verantwortest du die Zielerreichung des Konzepts und korrigierst den Kurs, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen. Das Budget für die Kampagne hast du dabei stets im Blick. Briefings und Kanalverständnis: Du erstellst strukturierte Briefings für Performance Marketing, CRM und Content, abgeleitet aus Kampagnenzielen und Zielgruppe. Du verstehst die Mechanik der relevanten Growth-Kanäle so weit, dass du Spezialist:innen präzise briefen und ihre Umsetzung fachlich bewerten kannst. Funnel-Erfahrung: Du erkennst und optimierst Wachstumshebel entlang des gesamten Sales Funnels. Das gelingt dir durch dein tiefes Verständnis der Conversion Rates und Mechaniken im Funnel sowie der übergeordneten Customer Journey. Experimente und Funnel-Hebel: Du identifizierst Kampagnenansätze für bislang ungenutzte Zielgruppensegmente und Lücken im Funnel. Hypothesen zu Kanalmix und Messaging überführst du in konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen. Die Erkenntnisse teilst du strukturiert im Team, damit sie in die nächsten Kampagnen einfließen. Erfolgsmessung und Dokumentation: Du steuerst deine Kampagnen über KPIs wie Net New Money, CAC und Effektivität. Entscheidungen, Annahmen und Learnings dokumentierst du systematisch, sodass sie für das Team nachvollziehbar und wiederverwendbar sind. Deine Auswertungen bereitest du so auf, dass sie als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen. Cross-funktionale Koordination: Du koordinierst die Umsetzung über alle beitragenden Teams hinweg – ohne formale Weisungsbefugnis, aber mit klaren Timelines. Du hältst Stakeholder auf einem Stand, verfolgst Meilensteine und eskalierst Blocker, bevor sie die Umsetzung gefährden. Auf C‑Level argumentierst du dabei evidenzbasiert. Das bringst du mit Background Du verfügst über mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem dynamischen Umfeld, idealerweise in FinTech, Strategieberatung, Banking oder einem Unternehmen mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten. Du hast digitale Akquisitions-Funnels und Multi-Channel-Kampagnen über Paid, Owned und Earned konzipiert und gesteuert. Du bringst Erfahrung und eine persönliche Affinität zum Thema Geldanlage mit. Skills & Fähigkeiten Du formulierst Briefings, die Spezialist:innen der Fachbereiche schnell umsetzen können, und bewertest deren Ergebnisse fachlich fundiert. Du denkst datenbasiert: Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sie und übersetzt Ergebnisse in umsetzbare Maßnahmen. Dabei bist du analytisch exzellent und detailverliebt. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit relevanten Tools wie HubSpot, Salesforce, Braze und Analytics-Plattformen. Du koordinierst abteilungsübergreifend, auch ohne formale Weisungsbefugnis, und hältst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen. Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, gegenüber Fachteams ebenso wie auf C‑Level. Mindset Du ziehst deine Motivation aus dem Erfolg deiner Kampagnen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Zielerreichung. Du gestaltest Strukturen und Prozesse in einer Transformationsphase aktiv mit und gehst Themen proaktiv an. Du gibst und nimmst fachliches Feedback und argumentierst auf C‑Level diplomatisch und durchsetzungsstark. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung! Das bieten wir dir Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500 €. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Erstes Kennenlernen mit unserem Recruiting-Team via Videocall. Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Case Study: Du zeigst uns anhand eines realistischen Szenarios, wie du eine Wachstumskampagne konzipierst, steuerst und auswertest. Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Investments und Vertrieb. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt. Google, Meta, LinkedIn) und hast Budgethoheit in deinen Kanälen: Du setzt Kampagnenstrukturen eigenständig auf, challengst und optimierst sie, verantwortest das Pacing gegen unsere Ziele und planst den Spend belastbar. title: Produkt- & Kundenmanager (m/w/d) – Software für die Energiewirtschaft
description: Die envago GmbH aus Leipzig entwickelt Software für Netz- und Messstellenbetreiber. Mit envago.EAST digitalisieren wir die Zählerablesung, inklusive KI-gestützter Zählerstandserkennung und Ableseportal für Endkunden. envago.WEST bildet Geräteprozesse wie den Zählerwechsel ab. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen der Energiewirtschaft, die sich auf funktionierende Prozesse verlassen müssen. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass unsere Software genau das tut, was der Kunde im Alltag braucht. Deine Rolle Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserer Software. Du kennst unsere Produkte so gut wie ein Anwender und prüfst neue Funktionen, bevor sie zum Kunden gehen. Genau dieses Produktwissen macht dich im Gespräch mit Bestands- und Neukunden glaubwürdig. Deine Aufgaben Produkt & Test - Du testest neue Funktionen und Releases fachlich aus Sicht unserer Kunden und nimmst sie ab. - Du erstellst strukturierte Testszenarien und Testfälle und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse. - Du beschreibst Fehler und Verbesserungsvorschläge so, dass unsere Entwicklung damit arbeiten kann. - Du bringst Anforderungen und Feedback unserer Kunden in die Weiterentwicklung der Produkte ein. Kunden & Vertrieb - Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden als feste Ansprechperson: von Fragen zur Anwendung bis zur Weiterentwicklung der Zusammenarbeit. - Du gewinnst neue Kunden. Dazu gehören Produktpräsentationen, Angebote und Verhandlungen. - Du stellst envago auf Fachmessen und bei Kundenterminen vor (bis zu ca. 12 Reisetage im Jahr). Dein Profil - Du hast mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung, im Vertrieb oder im Produktumfeld, idealerweise mit B2B-Software. - Du musst nicht programmieren können, hast aber ein gutes technisches Verständnis. Du willst verstehen, wie Software funktioniert und wie Kunden sie nutzen. - Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert. Fehler, die anderen entgehen, fallen dir auf. - Du trittst sicher und verbindlich gegenüber Kunden auf und verhandelst gern. - Kenntnisse der Energiewirtschaft (Netzbetrieb, Messstellenbetrieb, Zählerwesen) sind von Vorteil. - Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher. - Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B. Was wir bieten - Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zur Entwicklung - Direkten Einfluss darauf, wie sich unsere Produkte weiterentwickeln - Eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle zwischen Produkt, Kunden und Messe Interesse? 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who can execute fast, iterate with creative and funnel inputs, and scale what works. You’ll inherit high-performing campaigns and work directly with our CMO to double down on growth.

You’ll then also have the opportunity to test and scale new channels (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Native, ASA) depending on performance and market constraints.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Ownership and Scaling

  • Take the lead on one or two paid acquisition channels (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.), with potential to expand scope based on performance

  • Contribute to building scalable acquisition funnels, from execution to iteration, with aggressive growth targets in mind

  • Run high-velocity testing loops (creatives, audiences, placements) to improve CAC and LTV

Performance Analysis and Strategy

  • Monitor performance daily using tools like Voluum, GA4, and internal dashboards

  • Drive decision-making through deep analysis of CPA, ROAS, retention, and cohort behavior

  • Build and maintain internal reporting frameworks that guide strategic shifts and tactical moves

Creative & Funnel Optimization

  • Own the creative briefing process: define hooks, formats, and angles based on performance patterns

  • Collaborate closely with the content and product teams to launch and iterate on high-converting landing pages

  • Implement systems to reduce creative fatigue and increase speed of testing

Partnership Management & Media Strategy

  • Build strong relationships with traffic sources and negotiate premium placements and custom deals

  • Explore new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools) and build internal evaluation criteria

  • Stay ahead of ecosystem changes (platform rules, algorithm shifts) and adapt strategy accordingly

Automation & Scaling Systems

  • Identify opportunities to streamline acquisition processes through automation and internal tools

  • Create SOPs, playbooks, and experiment pipelines for scaling campaigns efficiently

Challenges You’ll Tackle

  • Scale existing campaigns to 3x+ budget while maintaining CAC/ROAS goals

  • Contribute to growing the user base from 30M to 100M users in the next 12 months

  • Execute 0-to-1 testing in new channels

  • Improve conversion through landing page testing and funnel iteration

  • Own both creative input and analytical feedback loops

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

Must-Haves

  • 4–10+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Proven track record managing $300K to $1M+/month in paid media spend

  • Full ownership of campaign execution, results, and optimization

  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, or native platforms

  • Analytical fluency: GA4, Voluum, tracking setups, dashboards

  • Strong creative instincts: can write briefs, analyze hooks, and iterate fast

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and funnel conversion

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Past exposure to subscription models and CAC/LTV frameworks

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth)

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

⏱️ Obsessive about speed, performance and iteration

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable advertising products based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €65K – €105K • Offers Bonus

Thorit GmbH · Böblingen, Germany · Hybrid · Full-time · Available immediately

About the Role

You'll be the engineer on the ground at our enterprise clients.   • Strong Python or TypeScript, plus experience with REST APIs, webhooks and integrating business systems (CRM, ERP or data platforms)

  • Experience working directly with client or business stakeholders, from understanding the problem to defining scope

  • German at C1 level or higher and fluent English

  • Willingness to work from our Böblingen office two days a week and travel to client sites across DACH

Nice-to-haves

You'll report to the Team Lead AI Engineering Germany, joining the AI Engineering Germany team within Thorit's AI & Engineering Practice. You'll work closely with our AI Engineering team in Lisbon, our UX & UI designers, and the consultants and project managers staffed on your client engagements.

Tech Stack

Python, TypeScript, LLM APIs (Claude and others), agent frameworks and MCP, HubSpot APIs, cloud and serverless platforms, Git and CI/CD, Claude Code, Jira, Confluence, Forecast.

What We Offer

  • 31 vacation days per year (30 plus one extra day for Christmas or a holiday of your choice), well above the statutory minimum of 20

  • Flex work model: two days in our Böblingen office, the rest where you work best

  • Learning budget every year for conferences, certifications and courses

  • MacBook and a full desk setup

  • Company pension (Allianz) with an employer contribution from your second year, rising with tenure

  • Business Bike leasing with tax advantage, unlimited private use and full insurance

  • Lunch subsidy of €5 tax-free per working day (up to €100 per month)

  • Urban Sports Club memberships

  • Corporate Benefits discounts from several hundred brands

Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. title: Strategische:r Einkäufer:in – Halbleitermaterialien (w/m/d)
description: Über uns Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern. Unsere Technologie Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung. Kurz gesagt , wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen. Deine Rolle In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Du stellst die Versorgungssicherheit sicher, optimierst die Gesamtkosten über den gesamten Beschaffungslebenszyklus hinweg und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen. Deine Aufgaben Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, globale Beschaffungsstrategien für Halbleitermaterialien wie Wafer, Fotolacke, CMP-Suspensionen, Spezialgase oder Chemikalien zu entwickeln und zu implementieren. Du identifizierst, qualifizierst und steuerst strategisch wichtige Lieferanten und stellst dabei sicher, dass sie optimal auf unsere Technologie-Roadmaps, Qualitätsstandards und Produktionsanforderungen abgestimmt sind. Beim Verhandeln von Verträgen, Preisen und sonstigen Konditionen hast du unsere Kostenziele immer im Blick und sicherst gleichzeitig eine verlässliche Belieferung. Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus R&D, Process Engineering, Qualitätssicherung und Fertigung stimmst du die Materialbeschaffung bestmöglich auf die technologischen Vorgaben und Produktionsanforderungen ab. Bei der Einführung neuer Produkte unterstützt du tatkräftig, indem du Materialien beschaffst, die den neuen Prozessanforderungen und Skalierungszielen gerecht werden. Du steuerst die Performance, pflegst die Lieferantenbeziehungen und kümmerst dich um das Reporting in Bezug auf unsere Unternehmensziele. Das bringst du mit Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Supply Chain Management, Ingenieur- oder Materialwissenschaften, Physik, BWL (oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang) Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Einkauf, Strategic Sourcing oder Supply Chain Management, vorzugsweise in der Halbleiterindustrie, Elektronikbranche oder Hightech-Fertigung Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfolge in Bezug auf Vertragsverhandlungen, Lieferantenmanagement und Kostenoptimierung Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Halbleitermaterialien und -prozesse, z. B. Wafer, Spezialgase, Chemikalien, Fotolacke, Lithografie, Ätzen und Metallisierungsmaterialien Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit ERP- oder Einkaufssystemen und Datenanalysetools Analytisches Denken, Kommunikationsstärke und ein gutes Gespür im Umgang mit verschiedenen Stakeholder:innen Verhandlungssicheres Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus) Die Bereitschaft, mind. 1x pro Woche in unserem Aachener Büro zu arbeiten Unsere Kultur Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel — wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst. Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Deine Gesundheit und deine Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden steht an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungs-, Renten- und virtuellen Aktienoptionen für deine geistige, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Dein Wohlbefinden ist unsere Priorität — heute und in der Zukunft. Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt. Wir verbinden Chips — und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließe dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will. Kannst du dich in dieser Rolle und in unserem Unternehmen wiederfinden? Let's connect. title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Your Role As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection. You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. raw.description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° bauen wir Europas führende Energie-Software-Plattform “Heartbeat” und schaffen so ein virtuelles Kraftwerk, das Photovoltaik, Stromspeicher, Wärmepumpen und Ladesäulen der Kunden verknüpft und so die Rentabilität vernetzter Kundenanlagen deutlich erhöht. Wir bieten Kunden zudem einen "One-Stop-Shop" für den Kauf und die Installation individueller und intelligenter Energie-Systemlösungen, damit jeder Haushalt schnell und professionell klimaneutral wohnen, heizen und mobil sein kann. Gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in unserer Technologie-Sparte an der Weiterentwicklung und dem Ausbau der Heartbeat-Software, um Kunden weltweit mit dem Strommarkt zu vernetzen und so immer den günstigsten und saubersten Stromtarif anbieten zu können.
Erfahre über unser Product & Tech Team!

Deine Position

Als Team Energy sind wir Teil des Product und Tech Teams von 1KOMMA5°. Wir arbeiten täglich daran, dass unsere digitalen Produkte tausenden Kund:innen weltweit zur Verfügung stehen. Wir wachsen stark und suchen deshalb weitere Verstärkung! Was zählt ist, dass du motiviert bist, die untenstehende Aufgaben anzugehen, Gas (bzw. Strom) zu geben und eine steile Lernkurve suchst.

  • Du übernimmst eigenständig KI- und Automatisierungsprojekte – von der RAG-gestützten Datenverarbeitung bis hin zur automatisierten Kundenkommunikation
  • Du nutzt Automatisierungsplattformen für schnelles Prototyping von KI-Anwendungen
  • Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Process- und Operations-Team zusammen, um konkrete Herausforderungen im Tagesgeschäft zu verstehen
  • Du dokumentierst deine Workflows in unserer Wissensdatenbank und machst unseren Teamkontext für KI-Agenten nutzbar
  • Du evaluierst neue KI-Tools und Automatisierungsplattformen und bringst proaktiv Vorschläge ein, wie wir operative Prozesse verbessern und automatisieren können

Dein Profil

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science oder ein vergleichbares Fach – oder bist tech-affin mit nachweisbarer Erfahrung

  • Du denkst in Prozessen und hast Freude daran, repetitive Aufgaben durch smarte Lösungen zu ersetzen
  • Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte hands-on Mentalität und bringst proaktiv Initiativen voran

  • Für diese Stelle ist es unerlässlich, dass du dich wohl damit fühlst fließend auf Deutsch zu kommunizieren (mind. C1 Niveau)
  • Du suchst eine steile Lernkurve und bist offen für Feedback - jeder Mensch kann dazulernen, genau dafür wollen wir Raum geben
  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft? Super! Du bist noch Rookie in der Branche? Kein Problem – für uns zählt Motivation und Lernwille!

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt, Berlin & München zu arbeiten und/oder remote
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen

title: HR-Generalist (m/w/d) – Personaladministration, Recruiting & Digitalisierung
description: Du kannst Personalarbeit – und möchtest mehr als nur verwalten? Bei uns erwartet dich keine große HR-Abteilung mit vielen Spezialisten. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unseren operativen Personalbereich mit rund 85 Mitarbeitenden – eigenständig, nah an den Menschen und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung und Teamleitern. Wir suchen jemanden, der Personaladministration zuverlässig organisiert, passende neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen gewinnt und unsere Prozesse Schritt für Schritt moderner macht. Aufgaben Personaladministration und Mitarbeiterbetreuung Den operativen Personalbereich weitgehend eigenverantwortlich betreuen. Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Bescheinigungen und weitere Personaldokumente vorbereiten und verwalten. Personaldaten und digitale Personalakten aktuell halten und administrative Fristen nachverfolgen. Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei alltäglichen Personalfragen unterstützen – verständlich, pragmatisch und auch bei unterschiedlichen Sprachkenntnissen klar in der Kommunikation. Arbeitsrechtliche Fragestellungen beurteilen sowie personelle Maßnahmen und Unterlagen eigenständig vorbereiten und mit der Geschäftsführung abstimmen. Mit Buchhaltung und Teamleitern zusammenarbeiten; die operative Abwesenheitsverwaltung bleibt bei den Teamleitern. Recruiting – regional und mit Blick auf nachhaltige Einstellungen Geeignete Mitarbeitende insbesondere für gewerbliche und operative Tätigkeiten am Standort Heiligenhaus und in der Umgebung gewinnen. Recruiting über JOIN, Indeed, StepStone und unser Programm „Mitarbeiter werben Mitarbeiter“ organisieren und optimieren. Bewerbungen sichten, Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten vorqualifizieren und Vorstellungsgespräche gemeinsam mit den Teamleitern führen. Nicht nur schnell offene Stellen besetzen, sondern sorgfältig auswählen, damit Menschen fachlich und persönlich langfristig zu uns passen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und den Führungskräften Anforderungen und Auswahlkriterien weiterentwickeln. Digitalisierung und KI Bestehende Abläufe kritisch hinterfragen und die begonnene Professionalisierung unserer Personalarbeit fortsetzen. Unsere webbasierte Personalverwaltung nutzen und Verbesserungen anstoßen; ältere Systeme und Medienbrüche pragmatisch berücksichtigen. Digitale Workflows und sinnvolle Automatisierung für Administration und Recruiting mitentwickeln. Offen mit KI-gestützten Hilfsmitteln experimentieren, beispielsweise bei der strukturierten Aufbereitung von Bewerbungen – mit Datenschutz, nachvollziehbaren Kriterien und menschlicher Entscheidung über Bewerbende. title: Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
description: <h2>About the Role&nbsp;</h2> <p>Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.</p> <p>The Associate Director, Customer Compensation &amp; Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.</p> <p>You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.</p> <p><em>The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.</em></p> <h2>What You'll Own&nbsp;</h2> <p><strong>&nbsp;Global Compensation Strategy &amp; Engine Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.</li> <li>Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.</li> <li>Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.</li> <li>Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experimentation &amp; Behavioral Economics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.</li> <li>Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.</li> <li>Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics &amp; Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Stewardship &amp; Cost Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global compensation P&amp;L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.</li> <li>Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.</li> <li>Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.</li> <li>Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Policy &amp; Global Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.</li> <li>Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.</li> <li>Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.</li> <li>Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; description: <h1><strong>Who we are</strong></h1> <h2><strong>About Stripe</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.</p> <p><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance</li> <li>Extensive experience directly selling a technology product or service, preferably at an API-first company, with a record of top performance</li> <li>A proven track record of moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition</li> <li>Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies</li> <li>An ability to understand complex technical problems and understand how Stripe’s solutions can address them</li> <li>A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal</li> <li>Strong presentation skills</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements</li> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment</li> <li>Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space</li> <li>Experience in or excitement in learning about financial technology infrastructure</li> <li>Fastidious approach to CRM hygiene and experience utilizing thorough sales forecasting metrics on a weekly/quarterly basis and communicating them in a succinct manner</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>In-office expectations</strong></p> <p>Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss.   • Lean-Initiativen durch geeignete technische Lösungen unterstützen, Produktionsabläufe vereinfachen und Verschwendung reduzieren.

  • Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Manufacturing Engineering, in der produktionsnahen Entwicklung oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Design for Manufacturing und Design to Cost und Erfahrung in deren Anwendung während der Produktentwicklung.
  • Gutes Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von Mechanik, Elektronik und Steuerungstechnik; Kenntnisse in der Optik sind von Vorteil.
  • Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und praxisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung und Produktion. Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Ergebnisorientierung.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten (nach individueller Absprache), 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Angebot zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge & Krankenversicherung
  • Förderung deiner individuellen Weiterentwicklung und Karriere
  • Breites Angebot an Gesundheits- und Sportaktivitäten (Urban Sports Club, Firmenlauf, etc.)

title: Senior Consulting Systems Engineer Germany, Strategic Accounts (Automotive and Manufacturing)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p> <p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><p><strong>Senior Consulting Systems Engineer Germany, Strategic Accounts</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>(Automotive)</strong></p> <p>Do you keep up with the latest trends, are you a disruptive thinker and do you have experience of driving cultural change in organisations? If Yes - then this is the right role for you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The Strategic Accounts business is the growth area for Everpure and the Client Technical Director (CTD), known internally as a - Consulting System Engineer (CSE) - is a key role in engaging new and existing Automotive clients in conversations to help them transition from traditional storage-centric models to a modern data platform - unlocking the power of their data.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As Client Technical Director you are a senior level technical Solutions Architect who will work with and focus on Everpure’s Strategic clients -&nbsp; for this role it will be German Automotive clients with a focus on southern Germany, plus other selected accounts. In turn, you will also work in collaboration with Everpure’s Enterprise and Field pre-sales and account teams&nbsp;</p> <p>You are expected also to have a detailed grasp of IT industry trends, broad and deep IT industry experience (especially Automotive, their Tier 1 suppliers and ecosystems, plus the wider Manufacturing supply chain and build demands) and a high degree of business acumen and will be working in the forefront of Everpure's global sales capability.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You will be required to work closely with your customer base (so frequent travel within Germany is a strong requirement), building a trusted relationship, identifying and quantifying outcome based opportunities that can be delivered from our portfolio.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You must be knowledgeable across industry, business, IT strategy, use cases and technology domains and be comfortable presenting to C-Suite clients, discussing process with business managers or working with developers on solution strategy, architecture and code, and with storage admins designing operating models – from boardroom to hackathon to storage ops. Critically you will be accustomed to creating a value proposition that is directly linked to a client’s business model, challenges and issues plus their future vision.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>You will be an expert in quickly learning new business models and drivers and will be able to articulate, to multiple customer stakeholder personas across different regions and countries. This will include presenting and explaining the benefits and differentiators of our chosen technology, how our solution has been mapped to meet their industry, business and operational requirements, our implementation methods, and the proposed commercial and financial models.</p> <p>Building and articulating financial and commercial models with their benefits to our customers, and internal stakeholders is a key aspect of the ever evolving role.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>It is expected that you will be able to translate our core values, differentiators and capabilities across our portfolio, plus articulate previous customer success stories, benefits seen and acknowledged by customers with known outcomes to multiple levels of stakeholders within the strategic accounts.</p> <p>You have gravitas and authenticity. You will be expected to have first class interpersonal skills combined with a comfortable, open and compelling communication and presentation style. You also bring a high degree of diplomacy and a strong EQ.&nbsp; It is imperative that we can look at our value propositions from the viewpoint of our customers, therefore empathy is critical.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE, AS A CTD AT EVERPURE YOU WILL WORK ON...</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Use Case Development and Solution Definition:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Define <strong>end‑to‑end solutions and use cases</strong> that address the specific realities of <strong>German and global Automotives </strong>– from production and supply chain to digital services and connected vehicles.</p> <p>Shape our <strong>global automotive strategy and footprint</strong> across the largest German OEMs and suppliers by mapping industry trends, business drivers, and technical requirements to Everpure’s portfolio and ecosystem.</p> <p>Influence <strong>implementation methods, technology choices and commercial / financial models</strong> so that our solutions deliver clear, measurable outcomes for customers.</p> <ol> <li><strong> Stakeholder Management:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Understand stakeholders, their drivers, challenges, their goals and expectations, and effectively communicate the right messages to them. You will spend a large portion of your time with your customers face to face, (in and around Germany primarily, but also globally covering the leading German Automotive accounts), your partners, Alliances, Global Integrators and key stakeholders.</p> <ol> <li><strong> Financial Acumen:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Calculate Total Cost of Ownership scenarios for customers, explaining how they align with their challenges and Everpure’s benefits.</p> <ol> <li><strong> Leadership and Collaboration:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Lead large IT projects, establish yourself as a thought leader and trusted advisor, collaborate with sales, engineering, and product management teams. Have experience of working across multiple global and local partners.</p> <ol> <li><strong> Collateral Production</strong>:</li> </ol> <p>Create client collateral, including presentations, papers, demonstrations, proofs of concepts, and contribute to joint offerings with other Everpure teams.</p> <ol> <li><strong> Sales Guidance:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Guide the Sales team in <strong>positioning, shaping and closing</strong> the right solutions in a competitive environment.</p> <ol> <li><strong> Technical Leadership:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Provide <strong>technical leadership and mentoring</strong> for the local and regional Systems Engineering organisation.</p> <p>Represent Pure at <strong>industry events, field marketing activities and communities</strong> (including those focused on women in tech and diverse talent).</p> <ol> <li><strong> Market Insight:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Track <strong>key trends in Automotive and Manufacturing</strong> (e.g. software‑defined vehicles ADAS &amp; AD, Industry 4.0, sustainability, data sovereignty and primacy &amp; AI) and connect them to Everpure’s technology strategy.</p> <p>Understand the <strong>competitive landscape</strong> and be able to articulate where Pure differentiates and how our solutions support the German market’s specific requirements.</p> <p>Bring back <strong>customer and market insights</strong> to influence our roadmap and go‑to‑market.</p> <ol> <li><strong> Culture &amp; Inclusion:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Help maintain and evolve Everpure’s <strong>technical and customer‑first culture</strong>.</p> <p>Act as a role model who <strong>creates inclusive environments</strong>, supports diverse talent, and helps us attract and retain top technical people</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE...</strong></p> <p><strong>1.Technical Expertise:</strong></p> <p>Strong technical background across <strong>infrastructure and data</strong>: storage, compute, databases, networking, virtualisation and/or cloud‑native architectures.</p> <p>Solid experience with <strong>data management and storage technologies</strong>, and how they support mission‑critical workloads in Automotive and Manufacturing.</p> <p>Understanding of <strong>key manufacturing processes and outcomes</strong>, and a <strong>deep appreciation of the Automotive value chain</strong> – OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, production plants, logistics and digital services.</p> <ol> <li><strong> Versatility:</strong></li> </ol> <p>Familiarity with areas such as <strong>data &amp; raw.title: Senior Account Manager- Kraken Flexibility (German Speaking)
raw.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken is seeking an exceptional Senior Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of Flexibility clients across Europe.

The role is responsible for building trusted stakeholder relationships, coordinating priorities across Kraken teams and helping clients grow and realise value from Kraken's portfolio of Flexibility products and services.

Working across multiple clients and markets, you'll need strong stakeholder management, prioritisation and communication skills. We're looking for a highly organised, proactive self-starter who can build trust, create clarity from complexity and drive progress in a fast-moving environment.

Experience of flexibility markets is highly advantageous. However, we also welcome exceptional candidates who can demonstrate strong stakeholder management, commercial awareness and an ability to drive outcomes in complex environments.

Fluency in one or more European languages, particularly German, would be valuable given the importance of the German market within our European client portfolio.

The role offers an opportunity to work with some of the most innovative flexibility clients in Europe and play a key role in supporting Kraken's continued international growth.

What you'll do

  • Own and develop a portfolio of Flexibility client accounts across Europe.

  • Act as the primary point of coordination for your portfolio of clients, primarily Residential Flex and, where appropriate, Generation Flex services.

  • Identify opportunities to help clients grow their flexibility programmes and increase the value delivered through Kraken's products and services.

  • Act as a cross-functional leader, aligning priorities across Delivery, Product, Engineering and Customer Success, bringing together the right people to deliver successful client outcomes.

  • Be the client advocate within Kraken whilst balancing the needs of the wider business.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of high-priority features, client commitments and critical incidents so that you can communicate confidently with stakeholders and proactively drive delivery progress by ensuring risks, dependencies and blockers are actively managed.

  • Provide clear communication, challenge constructively and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed outcomes.

  • Facilitate client governance, including QBRs, service reviews, strategic planning sessions and product roadmap reviews appropriate to the needs and maturity of each client.

  • Prepare client reporting, account health and forecasting updates.

  • Lead commercial discussions where required.

  • Ensure clients achieve meaningful outcomes and realise value from Kraken's Flexibility products and services.

What you'll need

  • Experience managing client relationships in a client-facing environment.

  • Comfortable managing multiple clients and priorities simultaneously.

  • Ability to influence and align Product, Engineering, Delivery and Customer Success teams around shared client outcomes.

  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.

  • Highly organised, proactive and able to operate independently.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to lead through influence and create clarity in ambiguous situations.

  • Comfortable navigating difficult conversations and holding others accountable.

  • Resilient, accountable and delivery focused

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships.

Preferred Experience

  • Energy industry experience.

  • Flexibility experience.

  • Experience of commercial negotiations.

  • Fluency in one or more European languages, particularly German.

What success looks like

  • Clients view you as a trusted advisor and advocate.

  • Client priorities are clearly understood and effectively represented within Kraken.

  • Delivery challenges are identified early and managed proactively.

  • Contract and commercial discussions are managed successfully.

  • Clients continue to realise increasing value from Kraken's products and services, supporting both customer success and business portfolio growth.

  • Flex priorities are effectively represented across Kraken, ensuring client needs are reflected in Product, Delivery and Customer Success.

Our Values

At Kraken, we are guided by the following principles:

  • Customer Obsession – We maintain a relentless focus on delivering exceptional client outcomes.

  • Freedom & Responsibility – We empower our people and expect high levels of personal accountability.

  • Get Shit Done – We prioritize rapid action and effective execution.

  • Purple – We remain human, curious, and deeply collaborative.

title: Europe Strategy & Operations Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About Faire</strong></span></p> <p>Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.</p> <p>We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p class="p1">We're looking for a strategic, analytical leader to drive growth and performance across our European and International business. In this role you'll personally own a high-impact portfolio of initiatives, doing the deep analytical work and driving execution yourself, while setting strategic direction and coaching a small team of individual contributors.</p> <p class="p1">You’ll connect the dots across product and go-to-market, using analytics, customer insights, and opportunity sizing to decide where we invest and how we execute. You’ll partner closely with Product, Operations, Revenue, and Data Science, and become a trusted advisor to senior leadership across the business.</p> <p class="p1">This is a player-coach role for someone who wants to shape strategy and also roll up their sleeves to deliver results. This role is based in London.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Drive OKR attainment for the International team, owning strategy and execution for our Europe Top 8 priorities</li> <li class="li1">Lead and develop a team of Strategy &amp; Operations ICs through coaching, prioritization, and vision setting</li> <li class="li1">Personally own key initiatives in Europe: identify opportunities that move company metrics, align cross-functional teams, remove roadblocks, and lead execution end to end</li> <li class="li1">Prioritize GTM and Product initiatives based on impact, strategic importance, and complexity, and partner with Data Science to build and refine the models that support those decisions</li> <li class="li1">Proactively identify opportunities that grow retailer lifetime value (LTV)</li> <li class="li1">Drive forecasting, performance monitoring, and metric decomps, and surface the insights that matter most to leadership</li> <li class="li1">Build effective, scalable operational processes and close operational gaps</li> <li class="li1">Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Product, Operations, Revenue, and leadership</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">8+ years of experience in consulting, finance (investment banking or private equity), or analytical business operations roles</li> <li class="li1">Experience managing and developing people</li> <li class="li1">Some experience partnering with GTM and Product teams</li> <li class="li1">You are an exceptional creative problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and structure a path to an answer.</li> <li class="li1">You are analytical and comfortable with data. You have strong analytical thinking and SQL knowledge, or the willingness to learn it quickly.</li> <li class="li1">You have strong product and business intuition. You can place insights in the context of broader business goals.</li> <li class="li1">You are a scrappy, resourceful executor. When something needs to get done, you remove roadblocks and find a way to make it happen.</li> <li class="li1">You are highly collaborative and influence effectively through others</li> <li class="li1">You are a clear, structured communicator, both written and verbal</li> <li class="li1">You have a strong work ethic and an ownership mindset, and you stay calm and perform under pressure and tight deadlines</li> <li class="li1">You embrace the adventure and do whatever it takes to ensure success</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salary Range</strong></p> <p>London: the pay range for this role is £141,000 to £193,500 per year.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).</em> Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.&nbsp;<br></span></em></p> <p><strong>Why you’ll love working at Faire</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Move fast:</strong> You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.</li> <li><strong>Equipped to scale:</strong> We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.</li> <li><strong>Best in class:</strong> Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.</li> <li><strong>Real rewards.</strong> Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Belonging:</strong> We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.</li> </ul> <p>Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our <a href="https://blog.faire.com/">blog</a>.</p> <p></p> <p>Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.</p> <p>Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.&nbsp; To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSczpI9me7nYKhunSC6AlagHKv75LHqfi-Qi2TP_3dpin0Uc9Q/viewform">Accommodation Request Form</a> (<a href="https://bit.ly/faire-form)">https://bit.ly/faire-form)</a></p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Privacy</strong></p> <p>For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s <a class="c-link" href="https://www.faire.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.faire.com/privacy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
