Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business. Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started. Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus. If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation. About the Role You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market . Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth. You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role . You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works. SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job. You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates. This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks. Role Scope People Leadership & Team Development: Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team. Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits . Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation. Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities. Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them. Product Discovery & Strategy: Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends. Decide where to invest and where to hold : set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business. Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth. Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed. Product Management Best Practices & Standards: Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development . Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis . Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning. Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints. Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality. Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination: Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio. Represent the company at external events, conferences, and industry forums to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends. Maintain alignment, knowledge sharing, and team cohesion with colleagues across the Group. Experience & Requirements Must have's: 5+ years in product management , ideally with at least three of them in B2B SaaS . Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation. At least two years leading a team as a people manager – product managers ideally, but we are flexible on the setup; what matters is that you have owned a team, not that you are ready to start. Experience taking a team or a product area through real change: new ways of working, a restructure, or post-acquisition integration – and bringing the sceptics with you. Demonstrable experience applying AI within product development , using AI-powered tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery. Proven track record of leading product discovery across multiple methods and translating insights into validated roadmaps. Strong commercial awareness : able to partner with Sales and align product decisions with revenue and retention goals. Data fluency : comfortable defining metrics, querying product analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions. Excellent stakeholder communication : able to frame trade-offs and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences. English at C1 or above , written and spoken, with the confidence to represent the product externally. Nice to Have's: Experience working in empowered product trios (or similar cross-functional squads) with engineering and design. Experience in healthcare (ideally the UK market, NHS) , public sector, or government-adjacent markets. Familiarity with platform or multi-product portfolio environments . Experience integrating acquired products into a single coherent platform. Polish or German alongside English . Not sure you tick every box? If you are strong on product leadership and craft but light on one of the requirements, we would still like to hear from you. Why Here Real ownership: you own a portfolio and the team that runs it. AI that makes sense: you'll apply AI to a platform customers already rely on, where it measurably improves how they run their estates – not bolted on for its own sake. A stable base for ambitious work: SINGU is profitable and growing , with consistently stable results. The role

As Finance Associate at Encord, you'll own the operational core of our finance function, including: supplier payments, customer invoicing, and month-end reconciliations - ensuring everything runs accurately and on time. You'll partner closely with the wider finance function and cross-functional teams across the business, helping make finance a great partner to the rest of the company. The day-to-day processes are yours to run and improve: where something is manual or unclear, you'll have the real opportunity to make it better. It's a strong fit for someone early in their finance career who takes ownership seriously and wants their work to underpin the teams building tools for multimodal AI.

 

What you'll do

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable, VAT returns and accounts receivable.

  • Process employee expense reports and ensure adherence to company policies.

  • Oversee client invoicing and manage billing workflows.

  • Assist with month-end close procedures, bank reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance.

  • Support financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis.

  • Collaborate on ad-hoc finance and operational projects as they arise.

 

Who we're looking for

  • Precision in the core. You take pride in managing the transactional heart of the company. You aren't just processing invoices or reconciling accounts; you view accuracy in bookkeeping and compliance as the critical foundation that allows us to move fast and make informed decisions.

  • A builder of systems. You don’t just accept manual processes as status quo. Whether it’s improving expense workflows or refining billing, you look for the "better way" to do things, ensuring our financial systems scale as quickly as our business.

  • Collaborative by nature. You recognize that effective finance isn’t a back-office function—it’s a partner to the business. You’re ready to bridge the gap between financial operations and the cross-functional teams building the tools for multimodal AI.

  • Ready for high-growth ownership. You are early in your finance career, but you crave responsibility. You want a role where your daily output directly supports our growth, and you’re hungry for the professional development that comes from operating in a fast-paced environment.

 

Experience requirements

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • 1-2 years of experience in a finance, accounting, or analytical role (tech or startup experience is a plus, but not required).

  • Solid foundational knowledge of bookkeeping, accounts payable/receivable, and invoicing.

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software and financial tools. An understanding of AI-native finance stacks would be advantageous

  • Proactive mindset with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, growing environment.

 

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Daily lunches & dinners

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

title: Principal Software Engineer (Hybrid)
description: <h3><strong><img style="max-width: 100%;" src="https://pages.8thlight.com/hubfs/Juan/New%20Careers%20Banner.svg" alt="" width="100%"></strong></h3> <h1><strong>Principal Engineer</strong></h1> <p><strong>Location</strong>: Waterloo, London, England, UK | <strong>Hybrid</strong> (1 day per week in office)</p> <hr> <h2><strong>Who We Are&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.</p> <p>Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.</p> <p>Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.</p> <p>If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <p>You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 10+ years. You are a trusted expert and leader, often called upon to guide ambiguous initiatives and architect scalable solutions. You bring a blend of deep consulting acumen, technical expertise, and product thinking that drives measurable and impactful outcomes. In your previous experience, you have:</p> <ul> <li>Built and shipped production-grade platforms: the reusable foundations, tools, infrastructure, and workflows that help other teams shift faster and more reliably</li> <li>Taken AI and agentic systems from prototype to production, with a strong understanding of infrastructure, authentication, and observability</li> <li>Delivered on&nbsp; high-stakes consulting engagements across multiple language paradigms, stacks, ecosystems, and client industries&nbsp;</li> <li>Built high-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served&nbsp;</li> <li>Led the development and delivery of production-grade software using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL</li> <li>Actively experimented with AI development tools and translated that experimentation into faster, higher-quality delivery for your teams</li> <li>A track record of understanding, assessing, and embracing new tooling and trends within the software industry</li> <li>Built or integrated AI/ML features into products and systems, including recommendation engines, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, RAG pipelines, and agents</li> <li>Successfully led modernisation and replatforming efforts to align legacy systems with short and long-term business needs</li> <li>Led and delivered solutions to architecture-level problems including scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and observability</li> <li>Facilitated alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders to move initiatives forward through ambiguity and complexity</li> <li>Provided mentorship and team support at scale, while sharing knowledge and improving team practices&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs</li> <li>Actively sought out and effectively given feedback</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do At 8th Light</strong></h2> <p>As a go-to technologist and strategist within 8th Light, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, while continuing to deepen your and our collective domain expertise over the course of your career with us. You’ll be responsible for:</p> <ul> <li>Rapidly building trust with clients, demonstrating technical expertise and understanding of their domain and objectives&nbsp;</li> <li>Driving platform engineering work at the client level, connecting long-term technical vision to what ships&nbsp;</li> <li>Leading platform strategy and delivery across diverse platform types, connecting long-term vision to what ships</li> <li>Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines</li> <li>Advising clients on architecture, scalability and platform evolution, connecting technical decisions to product and business outcomes</li> <li>Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring</li> <li>Driving innovation by proactively surfacing new technical approaches and product solutions</li> <li>Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives</li> <li>Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items</li> <li>Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values</li> <li>Designing and managing high-level technical roadmaps for large engagements</li> <li>Building your network and maintaining relationships with clients and other industry leaders within your domain</li> <li>Coaching client engineering teams, transferring knowledge and leveling up practices</li> <li>Influencing client CTOs and executive decisions. Planning and execute technical work that involves stakeholders outside of project boundaries such as across a client's technical organization</li> <li>Partner with account teams on planning, opportunity identification, stakeholder relationships, and pre-sales scope shaping</li> <li>Facilitating retrospectives, strategy sessions, and technical deep-dives to improve team and project outcomes</li> <li>Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress</li> <li>Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes</li> <li>Demonstrating leadership in scalable system design, modular architecture, and platform- or product-oriented development</li> <li>Bringing depth in testing strategies, observability, fault tolerance, and secure engineering practices</li> <li>Applying architectural patterns to evaluate tradeoffs and drive clear, documented design rationale</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strongly Preferred Skills</strong></h2> <p>We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/our-network"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">private, global, multi-cloud IP network</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">, to bringing </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/resources/about-edge-connectivity"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">hyperlocal edge</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.</p> <p>Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.</p> <p>This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.</li> <li>Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.</li> <li>Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.</li> <li>Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.</li> <li>Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.</li> <li>Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.</li> <li>Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.</li> <li>Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.</li> <li>Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.</li> <li>Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.</li> </ul> <p>Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.</p> <p><strong>How we'll measure success</strong></p> <p><strong>Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.</strong></p> <p>We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.</p> <p>We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.</p> <p><strong>Who will thrive here</strong></p> <p>Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.</p> <p>You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.</p> <p><strong>This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.</strong></p> <p>We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.</p> <h6><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-RH1</span></h6><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top 10 gross revenue Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p>This individual will own the long-view strategic planning across the game’s Features ensuring alignment between strategic vision and tactical execution. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!</p> <p>Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. title: Senior Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory
description: About the Team OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, commercial, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation. About the Role We’re seeking an experienced lawyer to join OpenAI’s EU Policy/Regulatory Legal team. You will own assigned legal matters and workstreams concerning EU and UK AI and digital regulation, prepare practical legal advice, and support engagements with the EU AI Office, other regulators and policymakers. Working with our Associate General Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory, you will assess regulatory developments, develop legal recommendations and help translate them into action across OpenAI’s products and operations. We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer who can work independently, exercise sound judgment in unfamiliar areas, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across teams. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your work while identifying material risks and knowing when to escalate. This individual-contributor role reports to our Associate General Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory. In this role, you will: Prepare for and participate in OpenAI’s EU and UK engagements with the European Commission, EU member states, other EU institutions, national regulators and policymakers, including briefing materials and follow-up actions. Advise on the interpretation and application of existing and emerging AI, digital and technology regulation, and translate complex regulatory requirements into practical legal and business guidance. Assess regulatory developments, enforcement risks and policy proposals, and develop legal recommendations for the AGC on their implications for OpenAI’s products and operations. Work with US and EU legal colleagues to deliver coordinated advice and progress assigned cross-border matters. Partner with Global Affairs, policy and regulatory affairs colleagues to draft legal input into policy positions, consultation responses, regulatory guidance, codes of practice and industry standards. Own assigned workstreams for regulatory inquiries, investigations and supervisory engagements, including drafting responses, coordinating factual inputs and escalating material issues to the AGC. You might thrive in this role if you: 10+ years of legal experience. Law degree (JD, LL.B., or equivalent) and qualification to practice law in at least one relevant jurisdiction. Experience advising on EU or UK technology regulatory matters and independently managing legal workstreams. Relevant in-house, law firm and/or government or institutional legal experience. Experience analyzing complex legislation and regulations, including technology laws such as the EU AI Act, Data Act, Digital Services Act, Online Safety Act, GDPR or Digital Markets Act, and the ability to develop expertise in new frameworks. Familiarity with EU legislative and regulatory processes and the respective roles of EU institutions and national authorities. Experience preparing for or participating in engagements with European regulators or policymakers, including drafting clear, accurate submissions and briefing materials. Ability to produce clear and concise writing, distilling complex concepts into simple, explainable, and persuasive ideas. Ability to work independently on assigned matters, exercise sound judgment and recognize when to escalate material risks or seek specialist input. Ability to move between legal analysis, regulatory strategy and practical implementation, and to identify the issues that matter most to the business. Ability to manage competing deadlines, coordinate contributions from other teams and take matters through to delivery. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to give practical advice and influence colleagues without relying on managerial authority. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. title: Brand Marketing Lead
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to join our Brand & Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help own our brand marketing strategy and campaign execution across six European markets and be part of our marketing team as we scale our spend management platform. If you're excited about building category-defining campaigns that move Pleo from a good solution to the undisputed choice for mid-market finance leaders and are passionate about brand strategy and creative execution, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to the Director of Integrated Marketing, and work in close collaboration with the Director of Brand Experience and Strategy, as well as the Brand Intelligence Manager, our brand foundations team, PR, content marketing and digital channels team. You’ll partner cross-functionally with PMM, MOPS, CX and sales. This is a hands-on, IC role, where you'll do both the thinking and the work—strategy and execution both sit with you. What you’ll be doing As a Brand Marketing Lead, you will: Own the brand marketing strategy that moves Pleo from ‘one of many’ to the undisputed choice for mid-market European finance leaders. Build and execute integrated brand campaigns from concept through to reporting — learning from what we’ve just launched, and pushing further. Create branded content that shows how financial services should be done. Content that recognizes the precision, rigor, and craft that finance leaders bring to their work. Manage the funnel strategically — balancing awareness, consideration, and conversion. Not just fishing in the pond of people who already know us, but earning the right to speak to people we don’t know yet. Own your budget and agency relationships — you’re the strategic partner they answer to. Measure what matters — working with Brand Intelligence, Integrated Marketing, Data, and MOps to track brand lift, earned media, consideration, and how brand work flows into pipeline and revenue. Set the benchmark for brand work in fintech — prove that category-defining campaigns come from strategic rigor and creative excellence working together. You’ll establish Pleo as the model for how brands should think about their audience, and show that understanding someone better than anyone else is a more powerful differentiator than any feature. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years in brand marketing (B2B or fintech might be helpful, but we care more about the thinking than the category) A portfolio of work that shows you’ve led campaigns from strategy through to execution — ideally integrated campaigns that work across multiple channels Strong stakeholder management skills — you can influence a room, sell an idea, and push back when something isn’t working Strategic thinking + execution mindset — you’re equally comfortable building a 6-month brand strategy and getting your hands dirty on day-to-day campaign work Comfort with ambiguity and pace — this is a growing company, and things move fast. You thrive in that Understanding of how brand and pipeline connect — you know that brand campaigns need to serve business growth, not just awareness A point of view on category dynamics — you can look at a market and spot where everyone’s getting it wrong A strong understanding for when/how to localise concepts, messaging & GTM campaigns across different markets. Fluency in one or more of our European markets is a bonus (not required, but helpful) Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want to reframe an entire category's conversation by competing on human insight rather than just feature parity. You thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you can build campaigns that serve as a 5-year foundation. You believe brand strategy must be grounded in audience understanding and directly drive business outcomes. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer purely high-level strategy without getting hands-on with day-to-day campaign execution. You operate best in rigid, highly structured environments with slow moving pace and minimal ambiguity. You view brand marketing in isolation from performance data, pipeline metrics, and commercial growth. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll: Map customer journeys across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments to identify brand opportunities. Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum. Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum. The location Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role Final Interview : A final interview with a senior leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace — this is a growing company, and things move fast. You thrive in that

  • Understanding of how brand and pipeline connect — you know that brand campaigns need to serve business growth, not just awareness

  • A point of view on category dynamics — you can look at a market and spot where everyone’s getting it wrong

  • A strong understanding for when/how to localise concepts, messaging & GTM campaigns across different markets.

  • Fluency in one or more of our European markets is a bonus (not required, but helpful)

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want to reframe an entire category's conversation by competing on human insight rather than just feature parity.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you can build campaigns that serve as a 5-year foundation.

  • You believe brand strategy must be grounded in audience understanding and directly drive business outcomes.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer purely high-level strategy without getting hands-on with day-to-day campaign execution.

  • You operate best in rigid, highly structured environments with slow moving pace and minimal ambiguity.

  • You view brand marketing in isolation from performance data, pipeline metrics, and commercial growth.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Map customer journeys across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments to identify brand opportunities.

  • Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum.

  • Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Why this role, why now

12,000+ companies trust Perk with their travel and spend, and we've brought both together in one intelligent platform. Every booking, expense and invoice adds to a wealth of data at your fingertips, and now is the moment to enable teams to use this data intelligently to power better decisions, precise reporting, and to create cost and time savings for our customers. Come lead the team that makes all of this possible.

The Role

Data is at the core of Perk's innovation and the backbone of how we will evolve our products using new technology. As our VP of Data, you'll step into one of the most influential leadership roles in Builders (Data, Product, Design, Engineering) with a direct hand in shaping Perk's strategy and success, and we scale our multi product platform.

Reporting to our President of Product and Technology, you'll lead a 40+ person organisation, with a remit that spans our Travel, Spend, and Events products. This role also spans our core functions and drives the business, including Customer Care, Marketing, Finance, Revenue and People. You'll join a strong, talented team with a clear mandate to shape how we create exceptional products at Perk, using our proprietary data.

Across travel, spend, and events, Perk holds a wealth of data that touches every booking, expense, invoice and payment. Your opportunity is to reshape it so it powers smarter, more intelligent products that keep us on the cutting edge of what is possible.

This is a role for a data leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, scales high-performing organisations through senior leaders, and has the technical credibility to go deep when it matters. You'll join a top-notch leadership team where we elevate each other, build shared strategies and win together. You'll help define how we grow and make decisions, with accountability for data across the whole company.

Your team

You’ll lead a talented, collaborative and innovative team who are excellent at what they do. They span seven crafts: Data Product Partners, Reporting Analytics, Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science and Data Governance. Together they power the work the business relies on every day, and they’re ready to take data to its next stage of scale with you.

Your missions

  1. Strategy and Roadmap. More than ever data informs everything we do and is core to the AI native products that we build. You’ll own the long term vision and strategy for data architecture, analytics, predictive modeling, and AI product integration. Work hand in hand with Product, Engineering and Platform teams across Perk to turn machine learning and advanced analytics into products customers love.

  2. Set the standard for trust. Own data governance, privacy and compliance, so security and regulatory requirements are built in from the start. Partner with our AI leadership to make sure the data behind every AI product is trusted, so everything we build earns customer confidence.

  3. Build a data platform we rely on. Run data infrastructure like a flagship product: governed, reliable, built for scale from day one. You own the budget and the build, buy and prioritisation calls.

  4. Lead with conviction. Unify the craft, standards and roadmap across teams so data speaks with one voice, and anticipates questions before they're asked. Be the data voice alongside Product, Engineering, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Revenue and People.

  5. Grow leaders who grow the business. Coach your senior leaders, shape the operating model and org design, attract top talent, and build a culture of ownership, autonomy and measurable results.

What success looks like

  • Data is the foundation of products that know our customers and anticipate what they need: personalised experiences, smarter recommendations and proactive insights, so they get answers before they have to ask.

  • You've built a high-performing, trusted data organisation that delivers measurable value across the business so all functions use and trust the data to shape decisions, inform strategy and change how we work, well beyond reporting.

  • Your teams operate with clear priorities, solid infrastructure and real ownership, and what they ship is core to our business and our success.

  • Lead and influence, partner with executive leaders to shape the questions and drive the decisions that matter most.

What you'll bring

  • Proven scale-up leadership. You've led data organisations in high-growth tech or SaaS, and you've built this muscle before.

  • Leader of leaders. You've scaled organisations of 40 or more through senior leaders, coached leaders of leaders and hired top talent.

  • Technical excellence and innovation. A data science background combined with analytics and data engineering, and the depth to push what's possible in any direction.

  • Executive leadership. You've owned a data strategy and budget at executive level, made the big build, buy and invest calls, and helped set company direction alongside senior leadership.

  • Modern stack fluency. Fluency across the modern data stack, such as dbt, Snowflake, conversational analytics and Looker or Tableau, plus the instinct to build your own tooling where it gives us an edge.

  • Trust by design. Deep understanding of data privacy, governance and compliance, including GDPR.

  • Partnership at every level. Proven trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Finance and Operations, and the communication skills to influence at the most senior levels and drive alignment.

  • Big picture and fine detail. You move comfortably between company-level strategy and hands-on specifics.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

description: <p></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="36"><em><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 2 Year FTC.</strong></span></em></p> <p></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p></p> <p>In this role you will oversee a subset of the growing PLOS journals portfolio: you will manage PLOS Biology and PLOS Medicine, with line-management of their professional Editors-in-Chief, and provide editorial oversight for a diverse set of journals led by academic volunteers across a range of disciplines in biology, human and environmental health. You will leverage your strong relationships with the scientific community to drive engagement and develop the journals to meet the evolving needs of their global communities. You will work collaboratively with the journals’ Editorial Boards, and in-house colleagues, to create and deliver against journal strategies, using your international networks to grow PLOS’ profile and reputation.</p> <p>The role is an integral part of the senior PLOS editorial leadership. As such, you will be expected to engage PLOS Leaders’ Framework—adaptive decision-making, empowering others, iterative learning, agility, resilience, systems thinking, continuous improvement, catalysing opportunity—at an advanced level. As part of that leadership, you will also own ad hoc projects across the entire PLOS journals portfolio. Priority projects currently relate to quality control, workflow optimization, cost efficiency, non-article research outputs (data and code), policy development and community engagement. You will embrace change, and lead your teams effectively through it.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><em><strong>Journal portfolio management</strong></em></p> <ul> attainment of multi-term performance metrics for individual journals</li> <li>Partner with the Publishing Director to develop and manage annual budgets, ensuring responsible decision-making and efficient resource allocation to meet both budget and quality standards</li> <li>Work closely with Operations colleagues and vendors to oversee optimization of editorial workflows, systems and reporting</li> <li>Work closely with Marketing and Communications colleagues to ensure promotion of journal content and PLOS’ mission, and to drive journal submissions and uptake of Open Science practices</li> <li>Ensure that Editorial makes effective and efficient use of cross-journal Centers of Excellence (e.g. Publication Ethics, Editorial Board Services)</li> <li>Ensure that the portfolio shares cohesive and consistent editorial policies and quality standards, reacting dynamically to changing community needs while forefronting Open Science</li> <li>Lead cross-journal initiatives, overseeing development of systems and workflows</li> <li>Oversee Editorial participation in community initiatives, conferences and events, ensuring equality of opportunity and alignment with PLOS’ mission</li> <li>Help to ensure best-practice document hygiene and information sharing by everyone in Editorial</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>People management</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Lead a high-performing and cohesive team of Editorial staff (up to 4 direct reports), fostering a cross-portfolio and cross-cultural mindset</li> <li>Ensure strategy is collaboratively translated into clear tactics for teams and individual staff, and monitor progress against goals regularly</li> <li>Lead by example, modeling open and clear communication and ensuring all stakeholders understand their roles and responsibilities</li> <li>Build strong relationships with Editorial Boards within a true partnership framework</li> <li>Address underperformance swiftly, sensitively and supportively, in collaboration with Line Manager and People &amp; Culture team</li> <li>Act as a thought-partner to, and deputize for, the Editorial Director</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Diversity, equity and inclusion</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Oversee improvement of the diversity of PLOS staff, Editorial Boards, peer-reviewers and authors</li> <li>Work collaboratively with stakeholders to eliminate bias in manuscript processing and editorial decision-making</li> <li>Oversee editorial participation in internal and external DEI initiatives</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Cross-sector&nbsp;</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Maintain in-depth industry knowledge, awareness of market trends, innovations and evolving customer needs</li> <li>Represent PLOS at industry events occasionally (approx 1-2 events per year)</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Qualifications and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>PhD and post-doctoral experience (or equivalent) in a relevant subject area</li> <li>Substantial editorial experience (5+ years) with progressively increased managerial responsibility in STM publishing required</li> <li>Track record in managing a group of successful journals and teams distributed internationally</li> <li>Passionate interest in science and scientists</li> <li>Proven commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion in science and scholarly publication.</li> <li>Strong business acumen</li> <li>Wide network of contacts within global scientific communities</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to think strategically, to innovate and to implement creative solutions</li> <li>Experienced people manager with a track record of managing high-performing teams through change</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal</li> </ul> <p></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The base salary range we've established for these positions is <strong>£90,000- £104,000</strong>. PLOS also offers a comprehenseive benefits package sumarized below.</p> <p></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">UK:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Private medical insurance</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Life assurance</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Income protection </span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Personal accident insurance</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Pension with up to 10% employer match</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Birthday and three winter holidays days off</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">2 days paid time off for volunteering per year</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-ccp-props="{}">Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>About PLOS&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.</p> <p>Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.</p> <p><strong>We’re committed to equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out.&nbsp;</p> <p>Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all.&nbsp;</p> <p>Visit<a href="http://plos.org/careers">&nbsp;plos.org/careers</a> to learn more.</p> <p></p> <p></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our <a href="https://plos.org/employee-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">Employee Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About Us

We're Team Granola 👋

Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters.

We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on.

About the Role

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale.

You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow.

  • Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role.

  • Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com, Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business.

  • Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious.

  • Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack.

  • Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security.

  • Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM.

  • Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues.

  • Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful.

  • An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably.

  • A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time.

  • Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use.

  • You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here.

About the Opportunity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

title: Senior Account Executive
description: We're looking for a Senior Account Executive to own full-cycle new-logo revenue for Cytix's biggest and most complex deals, in a market where most of the people you're calling haven't heard of us yet. You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads who are used to being pitched by categories they already understand. Your job is to earn a conversation with almost no brand recognition behind you, then run a genuinely consultative sale that gets underneath what a prospect is actually trying to achieve, not just what they say they want. You'll take on enterprise and partner-adjacent opportunities, competitive procurement, and buying groups that span security, engineering and the economic buyer. You'll also set the bar for the wider sales team: shaping how SDR intake and Customer Success handoff work, and helping newer Account Executives find their feet. What you'll do Own full-cycle new-logo opportunities from first qualified meeting through discovery, technical evaluation and signature, sourced by SDR, Marketing, partners and your own prospecting. Self-source a meaningful share of your own pipeline; build an account plan from a cold list rather than relying on inbound or SDR support. Run multi-threaded discovery across security, engineering and economic buyers, uncovering pain that a single conversation would miss. Own commercial negotiation, procurement and security review through to signature, including competitive processes, without needing support from the CRO. Maintain an accurate weekly forecast, with commit-to-close accuracy within 10%, sustained over multiple quarters. Shape SDR intake criteria and the Customer Success handoff standard; informally mentor newer Account Executives on deal strategy and technical positioning. Hand off cleanly to Customer Success at close, with deal-stage commitments documented in the CRM. What you'll bring 5–7+ years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally selling a technical product, not a service, into security or engineering buyers. A demonstrable track record of carrying and hitting quota of £750k–£1m+, at or above 100% in at least two of the last three years. Genuine consultative selling skill: comfortable asking why before pitching how, and building a business case from first principles rather than a script. Confidence selling into accounts where Cytix has little or no existing brand presence, building credibility through the conversation itself rather than a logo slide. A track record of pushing through setbacks and coming back stronger, and of actively seeking out the harder, less familiar deals rather than waiting to be asked. Genuinely bright and inquisitive: you ask sharp questions, pick things up fast, and enjoy getting to the bottom of a problem, whether that's a prospect's business or how Cytix's product works under the hood. Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you take ownership of them and lean in, rather than waiting for someone else to sort it out. Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone: new deal types, new buyer personas, situations you haven't fully rehearsed. What you'll get Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team. A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme. Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover. More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme. Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave. About Cytix Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words. We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you. Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still. Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale. See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it. Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics. Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.     Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

     

    Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.
